VI.description: Parses the ACTIVE project for DQMH modules and picks ONE module and ONE of its events by NAME - the front half every Delacor event menu function shares\2C without its two rings. A subVI of the headless DQMH wrappers\3B it scripts nothing.\0A\0AChain\3A Parse Project for DQMH Modules.vi -> Search 1D Array over the module names -> Delete From Array splits the selected module from the rest -> the rest are closed with Close Scripting References.vi -> Get All Events in Module.vi on the selected module -> Search 1D Array over the event names.\0A\0ANAMES ARE DELACOR'S SPELLINGS\3A Module Names read UTPump.lvlib\2C Event Names read SetSpeed.vi\2C because the event list is read with Prepend Type to Ring String? FALSE. Event Types to Parse is Delacor's own filter - Both by default\2C Request (no Wait) for a conversion.\0A\0ALIBRARY NAMES is Parse's All Libraries in Project - every .lvlib in the project\2C DQMH or not\2C as file names - which is what a module rename must not collide with. An empty Event Name picks only the module.\0A\0ANOT FOUND IS NOT AN ERROR. Module Index -1 leaves Selected Modules empty and Event Names empty\3B Event Index -1 means the event is not in the module. Event Found? is TRUE only when both were found.\0A\0ATHE CALLER STILL OWNS REFERENCES. Selected Module and Selected Modules carry live refnums\2C and My Computer is open\3B pass them to lvdqmh_close_modules.vi when the scripting is done. They stay valid only while the top-level VI that called this one is running.\0A\0ARequires DQMH installed and a project OPEN AND ACTIVE in the IDE. Generated by LabVIEWMCP\3B the Delacor VIs it calls belong to the user's DQMH installation and are not shipped with it.
